evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: load marker at the left panel with ochre and rust diagonals at both ends; by shot-08s the marker sits at midspan and the bars under it swap colour; by shot-20s a load-position heatmap shows each diagonal's sign across the sweep.
evidence.ambition: shot-20s: flat 2D canvas with a method-of-joints truss, a moving-load sweep, and a 30-panel sign heatmap inset; per-flip tones add an audio layer. One solver and one inset, with no depth, material or lighting.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: cream ground with consistent stroke weight on ochre and rust bars and graphite joints; the halo glow on flipping bars is soft. shot-02s crops the truss off the right edge, a framing lapse.
evidence.distinctness: shot-20s: ochre-to-rust force coding on a Warren lattice with a load-position heatmap; no anchor shows a structural solve. Palette is warm like anchor-12, but the idea and structure differ.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: truss runs off the right edge and the top half is empty, so the opening is not composed; shot-08s is a tighter cut; shot-20s settles on the full span with supports and the heatmap, resolving the piece.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet, so there is no head-to-head comparison to make.

critique.change: Add a depth or material layer to the truss: shade each member by its absolute force and tween each flip briefly, so the sign change reads through weight and light, not only hue.
Replace the hard bar swap at shot-08s with a short tween through a neutral mid-tone at zero force, removing the translucent double stroke around flipping bars.
Re-frame shot-02s so the full span fits the 1280 px frame with the load marker near centre; the right-edge crop and empty upper half are the opening flaws.
